stemMd: The graphs y = x² and y = 2x + 3 intersect at which horizontal coordinates?
explanationMd: Set the expressions equal: x² = 2x + 3, so x² − 2x − 3 = (x − 3)(x + 1) = 0. The two roots are three and negative one, both valid real intersections.

distractorRationale.a: Zero does not satisfy equality of the two functions.
distractorRationale.e: This loses the second valid intersection.
